head.title: Olympiads
head.subtitle: Olympiad rules, stages and the form for each grade, final venues and proctors, entries, results and awards. Times are Tashkent time.

states.noAccessTitle: You don’t have access to this section
states.noAccessBody: Olympiads are managed by the olympiad operator only. Ask an administrator if you need access.
states.errBody: The server didn’t answer. Nothing was changed — try again in a moment.
states.notFoundBody: The link may be out of date. Pick an olympiad from the list.
states.partErrBody: The server didn’t answer. The rest of the page works — try again.

list.title: All olympiads
list.sub: Each olympiad belongs to one season. Parents only see the olympiads of the current season.
list.emptyBody: Create the first olympiad: enter its rules, then set stages, forms and final venues.

create.title: New olympiad
create.slugHint: Lower-case Latin letters, digits and hyphens only: zinapo.uz/o/{slug}
create.slugErr: 3–49 characters: lower-case Latin letters, digits and hyphens; starts with a letter or digit.
create.titleErr: Enter the title in both languages (2–120 characters).
create.gradesErr: The highest grade can’t be below the lowest.
create.rankedNote: An olympiad for grades 3–4 is ranked: places, certificates and the season cup.
create.marathonNote: An olympiad that reaches grades 0–2 is never ranked: it’s a diagnostic marathon — no places, no ranking, no cups; families only see a skills map.

rules.title: Rules
rules.sub: These numbers are used when results are computed. They can change until results are published.
rules.certHint: The top this-many percent of each region × grade get a certificate (1–50).
rules.qualifyLbl: Spring online: top % qualify for the final
rules.qualifyHint: The way into the final for children without a ticket (3+ waves) (1–100).
rules.miniHint: How many children per region × grade are invited after the autumn online stage.
rules.bonusHint: Only certificates from the proctored final count.
rules.cupHint: How many children get a cup (1–20). Cup = ½ final + ½ gain since autumn.
rules.numErr: Enter a whole number within the allowed range.
rules.gradesLocked: The grade range is locked: children have already registered.

stages.title: Stages
stages.sub: Four stages, in this order. Online stages are taken at home without supervision, so they carry no big prizes — they only open the way to the final. Prizes are awarded at the in-person finals.
stages.notSetBody: This stage isn’t planned yet — families don’t see it.
stages.regHint: Leave empty to keep registration open until the stage closes.
stages.dateErr: Enter the full date and time.
stages.closesErr: The close must be after the open.
stages.regErr: Registration can’t close after the stage closes.
stages.formsEmpty: There’s no frozen olympiad form for this grade.
stages.formLocked: The stage is closed — its form no longer changes.

venues.title: Final venues
venues.sub: In-person stages only (mini-final and spring final). Families pick a venue in their region; a full venue closes.
venues.noInPerson: Set an in-person stage first (mini-final or spring final) — then you can add venues to it.
venues.emptyBody: Add a venue: families pick it when they register for the final.
venues.capacityErr: Capacity is a whole number from 1 to 100,000.
venues.startErr: Enter the full start date and time.
venues.seatedNote: {n} children are seated now — capacity can’t go below that.
venues.proctorsSub: A staff member with the proctor role. Never at a venue where their own child competes.
venues.notifyTitle: Send the details of “{name}” to families?
venues.notifyBody: The profile owner of every child seated here gets an SMS with the address and start time.
notifyList: Each family gets it once — those who already have it won’t get it again.
If the address or time changed, save them first, then send.

entries.title: Entries
entries.sub: Name, grade, region and result — what the job needs. Personal ID numbers and parent phone numbers are never shown here.
entries.noStages: Entries appear here once stages are set.
entries.emptyTitle: No entries in this stage yet
entries.emptyBody: They appear here as families register for the stage.

results.title: Results
results.sub: Computing can be re-run as often as needed until results are published. Publishing notifies families and makes results permanent.
results.noStages: Results are computed once a stage is set and children have taken it.
results.publishBody: Families are notified and results become permanent.
publishList: Each family sees only its own child’s result — no shared tables, ever.
Once published, results can’t be re-computed.

awards.title: Awards
awards.rules: The teacher bonus comes only from the proctored final: certificates at the final × the rate. Season cup = ½ final percentile + ½ gain since autumn.
awards.emptyBody: Awards appear here once a stage’s results are computed.

errors.SLUG_TAKEN: This short name is taken. Choose another.
errors.NO_CURRENT_SEASON: There’s no current season. An olympiad can be created once the season manager makes a season current.
errors.GRADES_INVALID: The highest grade can’t be below the lowest.
errors.HAS_ENTRIES: The grade range can’t change: children have already registered.
errors.WINDOW_INVALID: The close must be after the open.
errors.FORM_MISMATCH: This form doesn’t fit: it must be an olympiad form of this grade.
errors.FORM_NOT_FROZEN: This form isn’t frozen yet. The bank editor must freeze it in Forms.
errors.FORM_NOT_FOUND: This form no longer exists — refresh the page.
errors.STAGE_STARTED: Children of this grade have already started the stage — its form no longer changes.
errors.GRADE_OUT_OF_RANGE: This grade is outside the olympiad’s range.
errors.STAGE_IS_ONLINE: Venues can’t be added to an online stage.
errors.BELOW_SEATED: Capacity can’t go below {seated} — that many children are already seated.
errors.NOT_A_PROCTOR: This number doesn’t belong to a staff member with the proctor role.
errors.OWN_CHILD_AT_VENUE: This proctor’s own child competes at this venue — assign them elsewhere.
errors.RESULTS_PUBLISHED: Results are already published and no longer change.
errors.RESULTS_NOT_COMPUTED: Compute the results first, then publish.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This no longer exists — refresh the page.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You don’t have permission for this.
errors.VALIDATION: Some fields aren’t filled in correctly.
errors.NETWORK: The connection dropped. Check the internet and try again.
